---
title: "JQI_SatisfiedDemocracy"
output: html_document
---

```{r Step 1, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# Objective Job Quality and Satisfaction with Democracy
#
# Question:
# Do objective employment-quality dimensions predict
# satisfaction with democracy?
#
# Outcome:
#   satdemoc
#
# JQI dimensions:
#   compensation
#   benefits
#   earnings_stability
#
# Note:
# All JQI measures are assigned at the industry-year level.
# Individual-level OLS therefore treats respondents sharing
# an industry-year assignment as independent observations.
# These models are descriptive and conventional p-values
# should be interpreted cautiously.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 1. Packages
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(broom)
library(car)


# ============================================================
# 2. Load data
# ============================================================

gss_all <- readRDS(
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "gss_job_quality_primary_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 3. Construct satisfaction with democracy
# ============================================================

# satdemoc coding:
#
# 1 = Very satisfied
# 2 = Fairly satisfied
# 3 = Not very satisfied
# 4 = Not satisfied at all
#
# Reverse-code so that higher values indicate greater
# satisfaction with democracy:
#
# 4 = Very satisfied
# 3 = Fairly satisfied
# 2 = Not very satisfied
# 1 = Not satisfied at all

gss_all <- gss_all %>%
  mutate(
    satdemoc_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(satdemoc)),
    
    democratic_satisfaction = case_when(
      satdemoc_num == 1 ~ 4,
      satdemoc_num == 2 ~ 3,
      satdemoc_num == 3 ~ 2,
      satdemoc_num == 4 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )


# Check coding
table(
  gss_all$satdemoc_num,
  gss_all$democratic_satisfaction,
  useNA = "ifany"
)


# ============================================================
# 4. Analytic sample
# ============================================================

jqi_satdem <- gss_all %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(democratic_satisfaction),
    !is.na(compensation),
    !is.na(benefits),
    !is.na(earnings_stability)
  )

summary(jqi_satdem$democratic_satisfaction)

nrow(jqi_satdem)

n_distinct(jqi_satdem$year)

n_distinct(jqi_satdem$industry_common)


# ============================================================
# 5. Separate component models
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5a. Compensation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_comp <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~ compensation,
  data = jqi_satdem
)

summary(m_satdem_comp)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5b. Benefits
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_benefits <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~ benefits,
  data = jqi_satdem
)

summary(m_satdem_benefits)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5c. Earnings stability
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_earnings <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~ earnings_stability,
  data = jqi_satdem
)

summary(m_satdem_earnings)


# ============================================================
# 6. Joint JQI model
# ============================================================

m_satdem_jqi <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation +
    benefits +
    earnings_stability,
  data = jqi_satdem
)

summary(m_satdem_jqi)


# ============================================================
# 7. Predictor correlations
# ============================================================

jqi_satdem %>%
  select(
    compensation,
    benefits,
    earnings_stability
  ) %>%
  cor(
    use = "complete.obs"
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. VIF diagnostics
# ============================================================

vif(m_satdem_jqi)


# ============================================================
# 9. Compare model results
# ============================================================

satdem_model_results <- bind_rows(
  tidy(m_satdem_comp) %>%
    mutate(model = "Compensation"),
  
  tidy(m_satdem_benefits) %>%
    mutate(model = "Benefits"),
  
  tidy(m_satdem_earnings) %>%
    mutate(model = "Earnings stability"),
  
  tidy(m_satdem_jqi) %>%
    mutate(model = "Joint JQI")
)

satdem_model_results


# Optional save
write_csv(
  satdem_model_results,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "JQI_SatisfactionDemocracy_ModelResults.csv"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 10. Year-specific joint models
# ============================================================

satdem_year_models <- jqi_satdem %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  group_modify(
    ~ {
      model <- lm(
        democratic_satisfaction ~
          compensation +
          benefits +
          earnings_stability,
        data = .x
      )
      
      tidy(model)
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

satdem_year_models


# Save year-specific results

write_csv(
  satdem_year_models,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "GSS_Data_Cleaned",
    "JQI_SatisfactionDemocracy_YearResults.csv"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 11. Temporal heterogeneity:
#     Do JQI associations vary across years?
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Restricted model:
# common JQI slopes across years
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_time_restricted <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation +
    benefits +
    earnings_stability +
    factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Full model:
# JQI slopes allowed to vary across years
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_time_full <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Omnibus temporal test
# ------------------------------------------------------------

anova(
  m_satdem_time_restricted,
  m_satdem_time_full
)


# ============================================================
# 12. Focused temporal tests for each dimension
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Compensation × year
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_comp_time_restricted <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation +
    benefits +
    earnings_stability +
    factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem
)

m_satdem_comp_time_full <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem
)

anova(
  m_satdem_comp_time_restricted,
  m_satdem_comp_time_full
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Benefits × year
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_benefits_time_restricted <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation +
    benefits +
    earnings_stability +
    factor(year) +
    compensation * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem
)

m_satdem_benefits_time_full <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem
)

anova(
  m_satdem_benefits_time_restricted,
  m_satdem_benefits_time_full
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Earnings stability × year
# ------------------------------------------------------------

m_satdem_earnings_time_restricted <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation +
    benefits +
    earnings_stability +
    factor(year) +
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem
)

m_satdem_earnings_time_full <- lm(
  democratic_satisfaction ~
    compensation * factor(year) +
    benefits * factor(year) +
    earnings_stability * factor(year),
  data = jqi_satdem
)

anova(
  m_satdem_earnings_time_restricted,
  m_satdem_earnings_time_full
)


# ============================================================
# 13. Session information
# ============================================================

sessionInfo()
```
